post.description: A lead was created: in the app, through the API, the lead intake or a portal. Retried up to 3 times (after 1 s and 4 s) until the URL answers 2xx.

parameters.description: Message id (msg_...): the same on every retry; use it to ignore duplicates.
parameters.name: webhook-id

parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was signed. Reject old ones (e.g. older than 5 minutes).
parameters.name: webhook-timestamp

parameters.description: "v1," + base64(HMAC-SHA256(key, webhook-id + "." + webhook-timestamp + "." + raw body)), where key is the subscription secret without "whsec_", base64-decoded. Any Standard Webhooks library verifies it.
parameters.name: webhook-signature

event.description: Same as type, for older receivers.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer is retried.
